      Slitter Training Simulator

      Select Manual Doff to open Module 01. It starts in Auto, waiting for you to select Manual on the machine screen.

      Practice the supplied sequence using the controls. Correct actions appear green; blocked actions appear red. The seventh error restarts the module.
